fact: ICAP, with PEPFAR/CDC funding, supported the National University of Lesotho from October 2020 to maintain strategic information systems at 205 health facilities, and in 2021-2022 NUL co-led DHIS2 training for 518 users across the 10 districts.
title: ICAP Enhances Lesotho’s Capacity to Build and Maintain Sustainable Data Systems
